proximity_interpretation: Training-only auxiliary objective from within-sweep label proximity; not an annotation of anatomy and not a policy-invariant reward claim
training_reward: Increase in best observed WFSS plus 0.2 times increase in maximum same-sweep Gaussian label proximity among newly inspected frames only; initial six observations do not contribute to auxiliary potential
credit: First actions compare mean final return across four branches; each pair of second actions compares only its own post-first-action gains from identical history
loss_normalization: Equal decision-stage weights; average over branches/continuations and five action tokens
action_space: Observed image anchor plus signed three-digit frame offset; every unseen center remains reachable in all modes
primary_endpoint: Unchanged original subject-mean best annotation WFSS among 12 acquired clean frames; no proximity term in evaluation
checkpoint_rule: Final update 64, no tuning checkpoint selection
baselines: Matched anchored pre-RL replay; original v1 full after RL reported separately; uniform, random 100 repeats, random-actions 100 repeats, coverage, train-only location prior
development_gate: Full-history final score exceeds both its matched anchored pre-RL score and the strongest simple tuning comparator; inspect paired subject uncertainty before any held-out decision
heldout_policy: No held-out or BreastVid test admission; v1 evaluation remains held; any later held-out plan needs all checkpoints frozen before outcomes
limitations: Exploratory second development attempt on the same eight tuning subjects; representation, credit and reward changes are bundled, so gains do not isolate one component. A confirmed history claim needs visual controls and independent evaluation.
engineering_revision: The v2 smoke produced zero reward differences and unchanged weights; dependent arms were canceled before starting. v2b restricts auxiliary potential to newly inspected frames, initially zero. The exact WFSS endpoint is unchanged.
